messages:
oliver: Heads-up: partners asked for a clear timeline for the SDK/API breaking changes (auth header + batch rename). We need a plan that covers cloud marketplace images, hardware gateways, and SI integrators. Quick proposal below.
maya: Thanks. High-level please + who owns the gateway shim and the telemetry.
oliver: TL;DR proposal:
- Private partner notice: Day 0
- SDK patch release w/ compat flag + shim: Day 3
- Marketplace "compat-v1" image published w/ gateway shim: Day 5
- 2-week partner canary (select SIs + 3 HW vendors) Day 6-20
- Gradual enforcement on hosted API by header weight (10% -> 50% -> 100%) Day 21-28
- Public deprecation blog + joint announcements Day 30 (if canary green)
rico: Who's building the gateway shim image? We need it to run on our marketplace EKS/edge image and as an option for hardware partners who run edge gateways.
hema: Eng-infra will own the marketplace image. We'll bake a small translation proxy that maps old header -> Authorization and optionally rewrites batch field names. We can make it an env flag: RW_COMPAT_MODE=1.
neha: Partners/marketing: we need at least one week of review for joint messaging. Also legal requires a 30-day grace in partner agreements for breaking changes.
maya: For hardware partners, timeline's tight. Their update cycles are months. Recommend an "edge-gateway" distro we can support for 90 days and a vendor shim bundle they can flash.
oliver: Good call. Add long-tail plan: 90-day edge shim + drop-in C library example for token swap.
rico: Telemetry: add metric partner_migration.auth_header_v1_count{partner}. We'll use it to auto-flag top partners still on v1 after the second week. Can we get a dashboard?
hema: Yes, eng-sre will add the metric and a Grafana dashboard. We'll create an alert: if any top-10 partner > 2% v1 traffic after day 14, paging to partner ops.
neha: SI checklist requests: 1) smoke test matrix, 2) batch rename conformance test, 3) token usage report, 4) rollback steps for canary. I'll draft the checklist and attach to repo.
oliver: Repo will be partners/compat-migration. partners-bot, can you create it and add CI templates?
partners-bot: Repo created https://go.team/redwood/compat-migration. CI templates: unit, compat-smoke, and integration harness added. Invited: maya, rico, hema, neha.
maya: SDK owners: can we expose a runtime flag --compat-auth and a compatibility layer that auto-detects X-RW-Auth header and migrates it? Also a feature toggle for batch field mapping: --compat-batch.
rico: We'll accept a shim for one major release cycle. Add clear versioning: SDK patch releases will be v2.1.0-compat for this transitional window.
hema: Marketplace note: image will be tagged redwood/marketplace:compat-v1 and have a fallback header handler. We'll keep it for 30 days after GA and then publish a final remove image.
neha: Comms cadence: private partner notification (email + repo), then a migration webinar (Day 4), then weekly digest during canary. We should record the webinar and include migration scripts.
oliver: Example curl snippet for readme (add to repo):
```
# old header
curl -H 'X-RW-Auth: $OLD_TOKEN' https://marketplace.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' 
# new header
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $NEW_TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# runtime compat flag (SDK)
node client.js --compat-auth --compat-batch
```
maya: Also add automated migration tests: run partner CI against compat image and record diff in token accounting. We need to ensure no change in billing semantics.
rico: Billing: finance wants a report on token counts pre/post migration for the canary partners. Hema, can we surface that from the integration harness?
hema: Yes, integration harness will emit token_count metrics per partner. We'll wire to billing-team readonly dashboard.
neha: Legal asks we keep partner-friendly revert steps in the repo and include an SLA exception clause for hardware vendors that can't update inside 90 days.
oliver: OK noted. Risks: 1) hardware vendors lagging -> support load, 2) marketplace integrators not pulling compat image -> outages, 3) SDK release delays -> extended grace period. Mitigations: 90-day shim, staged enforcement by weight, extra QA cycles.
maya: One more: add a feature-flag gate in prod named ff.partner_migration_force_header that lets us roll back enforcement in 1 minute. Critical if we see unexpected breakage.
hema: We'll implement that flag in the routing layer and tie it to a runbook.
rico: Approve timeline if partners are notified today. No blockers from infra.
neha: Approve from partnerships/comms side, pending legal sign-off.
oliver: Great. Action items: 1) hema to publish marketplace compat image (ETA 5 days), 2) rico to draft SDK compat PRs (ETA 4 days), 3) neha to draft partner email + webinar invite (ETA 2 days), 4) maya to prepare hardware edge shim plan and C example (ETA 7 days). Please drop PR and docs into repo.
partners-bot: Reminder: "compat-migration kickoff" scheduled for 2026-03-28 15:00 UTC. Thread pinned to #partnerships.
